chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from one of his companions, having delivered with it by Zurara, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'May I be sacrificed for you! The fat which throws out the likes of it from the ailments, which fat is it?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'It is the fat of the cow, and O Zurara, no one has asked me about it before you.'

key_terms.الشَّحْمَةُ: Fat (specifically animal fat used in medicine or food)
key_terms.زُرَارَةُ: Zurara ibn A'yan, a prominent companion and narrator of the Imams

ai.seo_question: Which type of animal fat is considered a cure for ailments in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Zurara ibn A'yan inquires of Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) about the specific fat that serves as a cure for ailments similar to itself, a concept rooted in the principle of *tadakhul* or sympathetic healing. The Imam identifies it as the fat of the cow, highlighting Zurara's unique curiosity by noting he was the first to ask about this specific medical property. This narration underscores the Shia tradition of integrating practical medicine with spiritual and physical well-being, viewing natural substances as endowed with divine healing properties.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from one of his companions, having delivered with it by Zurara who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! The fat which throws out the likes of it from the ailments, which fat is it?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is fat of the cow, and O Zurara, no one has asked me about it before you’.
en.sarwar: 6. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn ‘Abd Allah from certain persons of his people (and) brought by Zurarah who has said the following: “I once said to abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘I pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause, ‘Al-Shahmah (the fat) that expels the same amount of illness, which shahmah is it?’
He (the Imam) said, ‘It is shahmah of al-Baqar (cow) and no one before you has asked me about it.’”
